verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community thread confirming gstack collects usage telemetry, with a reply saying users can opt out. This suggests an opt-out exists, but nothing in the docs confirms it or explains how it works. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the opt-out mechanism (config flag, env var or prompt), clarity on whether telemetry is opt-in or opt-out by default, what data is collected, and independent hands-on confirmation that opting out stops data collection.
